name: Spectral Terrace Pool
hours: Residents and their guests only; open late, lit from below.
sight: The tower's seventh-floor terrace juts over the cliff: an infinity pool that pours its edge into open sky, white cabanas, a bar of pale marble with a silent attendant. The drop below is two hundred feet to surf. In daylight it is blinding white and blue; at night the water is a slab of turquoise light and the stars start where the pool ends.
things: Swim to the infinity edge and look straight down
Be a guest at one of the tower's terrace evenings
Play a duel at the waterside table, the most watched casual table on the island
Accept a drink with fruit in it from the silent attendant
Listen to the elite talk shop: sponsors, agents, who is slipping
Watch the sunset here once, which ruins other sunsets
At night: find who comes up here alone
secret: Social summit: Jessica's and Ashton's parties (Magnus attends every one with his tablet and talks ladder; Anni attends to note infractions), Lilia's rare appearances (she swims lengths alone at night; a conversation here is how she first sizes Rowan up, if he gets an invitation). Octavia works at the far cabana with a ledger. A terrace evening on Day 63 or thereabouts is where Marrow is introduced to promising students — and looks straight through grey collars. Stage D: after Day 150 Lilia is here every night at the infinity edge, not swimming. Outfits here are swimwear and evening dress; Georgie, if present, is in a big T-shirt and is taken home early by Pippa or Willas.
access: Invitation only; from Day 67 guests must leave before the Night slot.
